nonthinking-general.source_basis: current official Qwen3.5-9B non-thinking general guidance plus project-fixed diagnostic seed; context length resolved to 16384 after verified local hardware/runtime inspection on Ryzen 7 5800X, 31.66 GiB RAM and RTX 3070 Ti 8 GiB; current LM Studio schema verifies stopAtLimit, llm.load.seed and llm.load.llama.autoFit

thinking-general.source_basis: current official Qwen3.5-9B thinking general guidance plus project-fixed diagnostic seed; context length resolved to 16384 after verified local hardware/runtime inspection; reasoning budget remains runtime-TBD; current LM Studio schema verifies stopAtLimit, llm.load.seed and llm.load.llama.autoFit

manual_only_until_programmatically_verif: any Bionic setting whose persisted key/value semantics cannot be verified
notes: Do not treat these profiles as permanent production configuration until controlled Bionic runtime supports them.
The current official Qwen3.5-9B documentation contains conflicting values for a specialized non-thinking reasoning profile; that profile is intentionally excluded here.
Thinking budget behavior must be runtime-verified in LM Studio/Bionic before a fixed value becomes canonical.

Context length is 16384 for the first controlled Eval-v3 baseline. The choice is intentionally conservative for the verified RTX 3070 Ti 8 GiB host and Q4_K_M target; 32768 is not accepted until real Bionic/LM Studio load/runtime evidence proves adequate margin and stable behavior.

LM Studio current schema verifies llm.prediction.contextOverflowPolicy with stopAtLimit, llm.prediction.llama.presencePenalty, llm.load.seed and llm.load.llama.autoFit; these are project-owned persisted settings rather than Team Master manual settings.
An absent explicit Chat Template override means model metadata/default may be active. Template identity requires runtime verification after Bionic start, not a manual UI setting by default.
Persisted Bionic model config is inspected read-only before controlled runs; unresolved fields remain UNRESOLVED rather than being inferred.
